Follow the savage Nornbear through many areas of the Far Shiverpeak in order to make Jora your ally.

==Quest information==
===Objectives===
* Help Jora track the [[Nornbear]] in the [[Far Shiverpeaks]] 
* Seek out [[Gunnar Poundfist]] in [[Gunnar's Hold]].
* Locate Sif in [[Sifhalla]].
* Defend Sifhalla.
* See Sif Shadowhunter for your reward.

===Reward===
* 2,000 [[Experience]]
* 250 [[Norn Reputation Point]]s

==Walkthrough==
Head out from Eye of the North into [[Ice Cliff Chasms]] to find Jora standing outside. Talk to her to find out how Ogden may be able to gain her help. After the exchange, head north towards [[Norrhart Domains]]. Upon arrival, your party will encounter the [[Savage Nornbear]]. Defeat it and it will flee. There's nothing else you can do so head northeast towards [[Gunnar's Hold]] to talk to [[Gunnar Poundfist]].

Gunnar will direct you to look for Sif Shadowhunter. Head back into Norrhart Domains and head northwest this time, towards [[Drakkar Lake]]. When you arrive at Drakkar Lake, your party will encounter the Savage Nornbear again. Defeat it and it will flee yet again. Head straight north to the northeastern corner to reach Sifhalla. There, Sif will ask your party to help defend Sifhalla from the Savage Nornbear's raid. You will be transported into an explorable version of Sifhalla where the Savage Nornbear will spawn momentarily. Just defeat it and watch a cutscene. After that, you will be brought back to Sifhalla and you can claim your reward and the follow-up quest (added automatically).

==NPCs==
All in [[Bjora Marches]], [[Drakkar Lake]], and [[Norrhart Domains]]

==Dialogue==
===Initial dialogue===
;Jora
''An unearthly creature, the [[Nornbear]], ravages my homeland, and it is my duty to stop it. I have tracked it throughout the far shiverpeaks, but it continues to elude me. My soul will not be at peace until this land  are rid of my wretched beast. The Burden is mine alone, although I doubt you will understand that. But, you will never gain the trust of our people until you learn our ways. Seek out Gunnar Poundfist in his Heartstead to the north. He will tell you more about my people."''
{{ Offer dialog
| accept = We will find Gunnar if that is your wish.
| decline = The less I know about the Norn, the better.
| ask = You are welcome to hunt as you please, but I must seek this beast alone.
}}

''You have proven yourselves capable. The time draws near when you must help Jora end this threat. To track the Nornbear, you must first invoke the wolf spirit. Speak to me again when you are ready to proceed.''
